nodes.summary: The thin Electron front end of the daemon; product logic stays in the daemon.

nodes.summary: The always-on overlay.

nodes.summary: The always-on process where product logic lives.

nodes.label: Door
nodes.summary: Answers a request; never streams.

updated.subject: Answer a send before the edge carries it

nodes.label: Worker
nodes.summary: Runs the outbox, events and lifecycle work.

nodes.label: Delivery
nodes.summary: Sends through providers.

nodes.label: Realtime edge
nodes.summary: The one live transport; it carries each signed bundle to the daemons.

nodes.label: Postgres cells
nodes.summary: The server store the door commits to.

nodes.label: SQLite replica
nodes.summary: The daemon's local copy, written before the door answers.

nodes.label: Cloud KMS
nodes.summary: Holds the content key; the door reads content only through it.

nodes.label: Cato
nodes.summary: Readies, verifies and lands pull requests onto main.

nodes.label: Clerk
nodes.summary: Sign-in for every surface.

nodes.label: Slack, Telegram and Discord
nodes.summary: Where Delivery sends.

nodes.label: HTTPS load balancer
nodes.summary: Fronts the door with one HTTPS address.

nodes.label: Door on Cloud Run
nodes.summary: Resident: an instance stays warm to answer.

nodes.label: Worker on Cloud Run
nodes.summary: Min 0: Cloud Tasks wakes it when work is queued.

nodes.label: Cloud Tasks
nodes.summary: Wakes the worker when work is queued.

nodes.label: Cloud SQL
nodes.summary: Hosts the Postgres cells.

terms.name: Door
terms.definition: The `virgil-serve` service that answers a request; it never streams.

terms.name: Worker
terms.definition: The `virgil-serve` service that runs the outbox, events and lifecycle work.

terms.name: Delivery
terms.definition: The `virgil-serve` service that sends through providers.

terms.name: Daemon
terms.definition: `virgil-desktop`, the always-on process where product logic lives; the Electron app is its thin front end.

terms.name: Records
terms.definition: The typed contract for the group's data, generated from one source in `packages/virgil-schema` into Rust, JSON Schema and TypeScript.

terms.name: Cato
terms.definition: The merge agent: it readies a draft pull request, verifies it merged onto main and moves main to that commit.

rules.title: The door answers; the edge is live
Product logic lives in the daemon, not Electron
The door never streams, long-polls or is re-read on a timer
Payloads are typed across every boundary
